items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...with Frank Sinatra. He had them singing with him on his radio show in 1944.

ctx.x: I don't think so. She never sang with the Pied Pipers, did she?
Oh, yes. Yeah. Not back in the Dorsey days, but later, when the Pied Pipers were an independent musical group, and with Frank Sinatra. He had them singing
with him on his radio show in 1944.
